name: Durnholde Keep
summary: Outlaws shelter in Durnholde Keep, east of Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills. The shattered fortress once served as the Alliance headquarters for the southern orc internment camps. Now the Syndicate holds its ruins.

sections.title: A Crucible of Captivity
sections.body:
After the Second War, the Alliance made Durnholde Keep its headquarters for the southern internment camps. Lieutenant General Aedelas Blackmoore commanded the fortress and its arena, where orcs fought for sport and profit. Blackmoore raised the orphaned infant Go'el as a slave, named him Thrall, and trained him to fight.

With Taretha Foxton's aid, Thrall escaped captivity and later united the scattered orc clans beneath the new Horde. He returned to Durnholde, besieged the keep, and slew Blackmoore. Then he called on the earth spirits to shatter its walls.

sections.title: In the Clutches of the Syndicate
sections.body:
Durnholde Keep has lain in ruins since its collapse before the Third War. After Lordaeron fell, the Syndicate took refuge among its broken ramparts. The bandits are dispossessed Alterac nobles and cutthroats.

From the ruined bailey and towers, they prey on travelers across the Hillsbrad Foothills. The old fortress now serves them as a fortified outpost.

faq.q: Why is Durnholde Keep in ruins?
faq.answer: Thrall returned to Durnholde with the liberated Horde to face his former master, Lieutenant General Aedelas Blackmoore. After slaying Blackmoore, he called on the earth spirits to demolish the fortress so it could never again cage his people.
The Syndicate holds Durnholde Keep. Its exiled Alterac nobles have become outlaws, using the crumbling ramparts as a refuge for banditry and attacks across Hillsbrad.

faq.q: What was Thrall's connection to this place?
faq.answer: Aedelas Blackmoore found the orphaned orc as a child and raised him as a slave at Durnholde. Thrall learned tactics and was forced to fight as a gladiator before escaping with help from Taretha Foxton.

faq.q: What purpose did the keep serve during the Second War?
faq.answer: Durnholde was an Alliance stronghold. After the Second War, it became the command center for the internment camps holding the defeated orcs, under Lieutenant General Aedelas Blackmoore.

angles.text: As an orc, you know Durnholde's ruined stones as the place where Warchief Thrall cast off his chains. His escape ended decades of orcish captivity and kindled the Horde's rebirth.
As an Alliance member, you know Durnholde's shattered ramparts once guarded Lordaeron and upheld its justice. Now Syndicate outlaws and cutthroats make their lair there.
